plugin.name: os-fleet-agent
plugin.title: OFME Fleet Agent
plugin.description: Connects this OPNsense firewall to OPNsense Fleet Manager Enterprise (OFME). The agent enrolls the firewall with an X.509 device certificate, publishes heartbeat telemetry, polls for operational commands, renews its certificate automatically and can apply the centrally managed alias and firewall policy.
plugin.author: SaarLor-Computec GmbH
